cases.translation: The Lord's command about the restoration of the temple
cases.explain: The preposition 'о' governs the prepositional case, but this genitive shows possession of the restoration.

cases.translation: Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah
cases.explain: Nominative case in apposition to the subject Zerubbabel.

cases.translation: The word of the Lord through the prophet Haggai
cases.explain: The preposition 'через' (through) governs the accusative, but genitive is used for 'word of'.

cases.sentence: Вы посеяли много, но собрали мало в ___ этом
cases.translation: You sowed much, but gathered little in this year
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) governs the prepositional case for time expressions.

cases.sentence: Поднимитесь в горы, принесите дерева и постройте ___
cases.translation: Go up to the mountains, bring wood and build a house
cases.explain: The direct object of the imperative verb 'постройте' (build) takes the accusative case, which coincides with the nominative for masculine inanimate nouns.

cases.translation: The ruins of the Lord's house lay before him
cases.explain: Possession is expressed with the genitive case: 'house of the Lord'.

cases.sentence: Я наслал засуху на поля и на ___ этой
cases.translation: I sent drought on the fields and on this land
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) here takes the genitive in the sense of 'upon/over'.

cases.sentence: И народ послушались голоса ___ их Бога
cases.translation: And the people obeyed the voice of their God the Lord
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession: 'the voice of their God'.

reading.ru: На втором году правления царя Дария, в первый день шестого месяца, было слово Господа через пророка Агея.
reading.question: During what period and through whom did God's word come?
options: In the second year of Darius's reign through the prophet Haggai
In the first year of Darius's reign through Joshua
In the third year through Zechariah
In the fourth year through Jeremiah
reading.correct: In the second year of Darius's reign through the prophet Haggai
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'На втором году правления царя Дария... было слово Господа через пророка Агея' (In the second year of Darius's reign... the word of the Lord came through the prophet Haggai).

reading.ru: А вам разве время жить в хороших домах, когда этот дом лежит в развалинах?
reading.question: What criticism does God make about the people's priorities?
options: They live in good houses while the Lord's house lies in ruins
They ignore the poor in the city
They refuse to work on rebuilding
They waste their money on idols
reading.correct: They live in good houses while the Lord's house lies in ruins
reading.explain: God questions why they live in comfortable homes while His house remains desolate: 'А вам разве время жить в хороших домах, когда этот дом лежит в развалинах?'

reading.ru: Вы посеяли много, а собрали мало. Вы едите, но не наедаетесь. Вы пьете, но не напиваетесь.
reading.question: What pattern of futility does the Lord describe?
options: Work yields little harvest; food doesn't satisfy hunger or thirst
The crops fail to grow at all
Animals eat the grain before harvest
reading.correct: Work yields little harvest; food doesn't satisfy hunger or thirst
reading.explain: The passage repeats the pattern: sowing much but harvesting little, eating but not being satisfied, drinking but not being filled.

reading.ru: Подумайте о своих путях. Поднимитесь в горы, принесите дерева и построите дом.
reading.question: What action does God command the people to take?
options: Go to the mountains, bring wood, and build the temple
Gather in the city and pray
Plant seeds for the next harvest
reading.correct: Go to the mountains, bring wood, and build the temple
reading.explain: God explicitly commands: 'Поднимитесь в горы, принесите дерева и построите дом' (Go up to the mountains, bring wood and build the house).

reading.ru: И Зерававель, сын Шеалтеила, с первосвященником Иисусом, сыном Иосидека, и со всем остальным народом послушались голоса Господа их Бога.
reading.question: How did Zerubbabel and the high priest Joshua respond to God's message?
options: They obeyed the voice of their God the Lord
They ignored the message and continued building their homes
They consulted with the king before responding
They sent word that they would obey later
reading.correct: They obeyed the voice of their God the Lord
reading.explain: The text states they 'послушались голоса Господа их Бога' (obeyed the voice of their God the Lord).

reading.ru: Они пришли и начали трудиться в храме Господа сил, их Бога, в двадцать четвертый день шестого месяца второго года правления царя Дария.
reading.question: When did the people begin working on the temple?
options: On the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius's reign
On the first day of the seventh month
On the fifteenth day of the ninth month
On the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month
reading.correct: On the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius's reign
reading.explain: The text explicitly specifies the date: 'в двадцать четвертый день шестого месяца второго года правления царя Дария' (on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius's reign).
